item.entropyinversion.entropy_inversion_: Right-click to aim; crouch and right-click to select an attack mode.
Click briefly to lock a target · Hold 1 second to strike.
Crouch + right-click to change attack mode.
attack_mode.entropyinversion.entropy_inv: Erases blocks and living creatures within the strike area.
The area is a cylinder spanning the world's minimum to maximum build height.
It destroys bedrock as well, leaving scorch marks outside the strike area after impact.
attack_mode.entropyinversion.asteroid_bo: Guides a nearby asteroid to crash at the target, destroying blocks and living creatures in range.
The selected range is cylindrical and determines the size of the guided asteroid.
The actual impact area is spherical, so deeply buried targets may not be hit.
The impact leaves a crater slightly deeper than the target, with the fallen asteroid at its center.
attack_mode.entropyinversion.anti_organi: Releases microbots to eliminate all living creatures in range.
The area is a cylinder spanning the world's minimum to maximum build height.
The tiny robots pass through blocks and pursue hidden creatures deep underground without damaging terrain.
